name: portfolio-rag
description: Cloudflare Worker backing the 'Ask about my work' widget on ajaykumarbalakannan.com

scripts.logs: wrangler d1 execute portfolio-chat-logs --remote --json --command "SELECT asked_at, session, turn, question, answer, country FROM turns ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 40" | python3 ../scripts/format_chats.py
scripts.logs:today: wrangler d1 execute portfolio-chat-logs --remote --json --command "SELECT asked_at, session, turn, question, answer, country FROM turns WHERE date(asked_at) = date('now') ORDER BY id DESC" | python3 ../scripts/format_chats.py
scripts.logs:count: wrangler d1 execute portfolio-chat-logs --remote --json --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_turns, COUNT(DISTINCT session) AS conversations, MAX(asked_at) AS latest FROM turns" | python3 ../scripts/format_chats.py
scripts.visitors: wrangler d1 execute portfolio-chat-logs --remote --json --command "SELECT substr(started_at,1,16) AS started, city, region, country, network, turn_count AS turns, first_question FROM sessions ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 40" | python3 ../scripts/format_sessions.py
scripts.networks: wrangler d1 execute portfolio-chat-logs --remote --json --command "SELECT COALESCE(network,'(unknown)') AS network, COALESCE(city,'') AS city, COUNT(*) AS visits, SUM(turn_count) AS messages, MAX(substr(started_at,1,10)) AS last_seen FROM sessions GROUP BY network, city ORDER BY visits DESC, last_seen DESC" | python3 ../scripts/format_sessions.py
scripts.stats: wrangler d1 execute portfolio-chat-logs --remote --json --command "SELECT substr(started_at,1,10) AS day, COUNT(*) AS conversations, SUM(turn_count) AS messages, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(city,country)) AS places FROM sessions GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 30" | python3 ../scripts/format_sessions.py
